name: Barbados (colony, 1870–1966)
description: A British Blue Ensign with the Union Flag in the canton and the colonial seal of Barbados, Britannia riding a seahorse, on a disc in the fly.
history: Blue Ensign defaced with the seal of the colony of Barbados, showing Britannia with a trident on a seahorse; the seal was granted in 1870 and the flag remained in use, apart from the years of the West Indies Federation, until the broken-trident flag was adopted at independence on 30 November 1966.

features.role: colonial seal of Barbados with Britannia on a seahorse
